items.title: The S&P 500 is in a correction. Bear markets and recessions don't always follow
items.summary: The S&P 500 fell into a correction on Nov. 20 for the first time since April 2025 as stocks pulled back sharply from October's record highs.

items.title: Liesman: Nvidia whiplash tests Kevin Warsh’s push to read market signals
items.summary: The extreme market gyrations and the drama surrounding Nvidia this past week have highlighted the dilemma facing Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh .

items.title: China’s factories are growing profits again, but the AI boom is picking the winners
items.summary: China's industrial profits in October grew at their fastest pace since May, supported by an AI-driven electronics boom and higher energy prices, while consumer-facing industries squeezed by weak demand continued to be a drag.

items.title: ‘Ready for any storm’: UAE minister optimistic on economy as IMF lifts forecast
items.summary: The UAE is "very optimistic" about achieving 7%-8% growth next year, the country's economy and tourism minister Abdulla bin Touq Al Marri told CNBC after the latest data from the International Monetary Fund showed the country would avoid a recession in 2026.
